statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Registro Único Empresarial y Social (RUES) – https://www.rues.org.co, operated through the local Cámara de Comercio (e.g., Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá, Cámara de Comercio de Medellín)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: All corporate names must be expressed in Spanish and may include foreign words only if they are of common commercial use and written in Latin script; the transliteration must follow Spanish phonetic rules. The name must be composed of an identifiable wording or denomination followed by the token 'S.A.S.'; accent marks and Spanish orthography are required; homonomic similarity with existing names is prohibited.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: NOMBRE SIMILAR A PERSONA NATURAL REGISTRADA
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If the Cámara de Comercio rejects a name on grounds of identity or confusing similarity with an existing trademark or company name, the applicant may file a reconsideration request within ten (10) business days before the same Chamber, attaching a written explanation and, where possible, a trademark search report. If the rejection is based on prohibited or reserved tokens, the applicant must obtain the corresponding prior ministerial authorization (e.g., Coljuegos for gaming-related tokens) or modify the name and re-submit via the RUES portal.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Virtual offices are permissible for administrative and correspondence purposes provided the registered address is a physical location in Colombia where legal notifications, service of process and tax communications can be received and is validly registered with the Chamber of Commerce and DIAN. For the social casino publishing activity, a virtual office is acceptable for incorporation, but the company must maintain appropriate substance evidence such as contracts, insurance, local representation and financial records.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: 25% probability of unannounced physical inspection within the first 12 months for virtual-office addresses, and 15% for a dedicated lease; inspections may be triggered by tax inconsistencies, third-party reports, or AML investigations. The risk increases to approximately 35% if the company engages in frequent outbound wire transfers without documented local substance.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Ley 1258 de 2008 (Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada), arts. 1-5, 17-22; Código de Comercio de Colombia, arts. 110-124; Ley 2069 de 2020, arts. 14-18.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá (Registro Mercantil, portal virtual www.ccb.org.co) and Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN, Registro Único Tributario).
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Documento Privado de Constitución de Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada, inscrito en el Registro Mercantil de la Cámara de Comercio, con acta de nombramiento de representante legal.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum legal capital for S.A.S.; subscribed capital may be paid in installments over a maximum of two years, with no escrow account requirement under Law 1258/2008.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: FIRST BOARD RESOLUTION OF [COMPANY NAME] S.A.S. At a meeting held in Bogotá D.C., the founding shareholder(s) unanimously resolved: 1. To approve incorporation under Law 1258 of 2008, adopting the by-laws and corporate purpose of software publishing, including development of simulated social-casino and virtual slots applications distributed through Apple IAP and Google Play Billing. 2. To ratify the subscription of share capital and authorize the Legal Representative to collect outstanding installments within the statutory two-year term. 3. To adopt the registered office at [address], establishing domicile in Bogotá D.C. 4. To appoint [Name] as Legal Representative, [Name] as President, and [Name] as Secretary, granting the Legal Representative full powers to execute commercial registry filings, DIAN tax registrations, banking account opening, and employment registrations.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá, online homonym search portal (Certificado de Homonimia).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File an online name availability request with at least three proposed corporate names. The Chamber of Commerce issues a homonymy certificate valid for 30 days, confirming no identical registered entity exists.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected due to identical or confusingly similar registration, re-submit within 10 days with alternative names; no fee is refunded for repeated validation applications.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution and Notarization of Incorporation Instrument
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary Public of Bogotá D.C. (optional unless real property is contributed) and founding shareholder(s).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Execute the private incorporation document (Documento Privado de Constitución) containing by-laws, share subscription, corporate purpose, and designation of administrators. If real property is contributed, elevate the document to public deed before a notary.
required_dossiers: Share subscription schedule and capital payment terms
Notarial authentication of signatures where required
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Any defect in the instrument is cured by executing a corrective agreement (aclaratoria) among shareholders and registering the rectification with the Chamber of Commerce within 30 days of detection.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Commercial Registry Filing at the Chamber of Commerce
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá, Registro Mercantil (physical window or virtual portal with certified electronic signature).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the executed incorporation instrument, the signed registration forms (Formulario RUES), and payment proof of the registration tariff. The Chamber verifies statutory compliance and issues the Commercial Registry Certificate (Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal).
required_dossiers: Documento Privado de Constitución (original and copy)
Formulario de Registro Único Empresarial y Social (RUES)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is queried, file a corrective memo (recurso de reposición) with the Chamber within 30 days; pay any applicable surcharge and re-register the corrected instrument.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax Registry at DIAN and Electronic Signature Activation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN), online portal www.dian.gov.co.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Using the pre-RUT and Commercial Registry Certificate, complete the definitive RUT registration ass a responsible for the income tax and VAT regime. Activate electronic invoicing (facturación electrónica) and obtain the company NIT and digital certificate for future tax filings.
required_dossiers: Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal (Chamber of Commerce)
Email and mobile registered with DIAN
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: RUT inconsistencies are cured by submitting an actualización del RUT form online or at DIAN local offices; penalties for late updating apply only when income or tax benefits are misrepresented.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Municipal Licenses, Labor Registrations, and Bank Account Opening
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Secretaría Distrital de Hacienda (Registro de Industria y Comercio), Cámara de Comercio, ARL (Administradora de Riesgos Laborales), and authorized Colombian banking entity.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Declare the company under municipal industry and commerce tax (ICA) with economic activity 5820, register employees and payroll with an ARL and pension/health fund, and open a corporate bank account for treasury and payment settlement of Apple IAP and Google Play Billing proceeds.
required_dossiers: Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal
Employer registration forms (Planilla de afiliaciones a seguridad social)
Beneficial ownership declaration (Beneficiario Final) as required by Law 2010/2019
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank or municipal registry rejects the filing due to incomplete beneficial ownership data, re-submit with corrected declarations; delayed ICA registration may be cured by filing a retrospective return with interest.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Coljuegos (Empresa Industrial y Comercial del Estado, regulatory body for gambling) and Ministerio de Tecnologías de la Información y las Comunicaciones (MinTIC) for digital content services. No Coljuegos authorization is applicable because the social-casino operation excludes any real-money wagering or prize payouts.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Declaración de No Sujeción a Licencia de Juegos de Suerte y Azar — Social Casino Activity without Real Money Betting (self-declaration filed with Coljuegos and retained as compliance evidence)

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Autoridad Nacional de Licencias Ambientales (ANLA) and Secretaría Distrital de Ambiente (SDA) of Bogotá
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt from Full EIA — Software publishing (ISIC 5820) generates no industrial process emissions; a simple environmental registration for office operations and electronic waste handling is required under SDA Resolution 1512/2010.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Domestic wastewater discharges from the software office must not exceed BOD5 of 100 mg/L and TSS of 100 mg/L per Resolution 631/2015; VOC emissions from HVAC maintenance remain negligible; e-waste and toner cartridges must be destined for authorized recyclers under Decree 1076/2015 and national extended-producer-responsibility guidelines.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Certificado de Bomberos de Bogotá (fire safety inspection certificate for the commercial office), structural load clearance for the server room and office facilities issued by a licensed civil engineer, mandatory ARL workplace risk assessment (Decreto 1382/2020) including an emergency prevention and evacuation plan, and municipal land-use compatibility certification (uso del suelo) for e-commerce office activities.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN) – Portal: https://www.dian.gov.co
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Foreign or locally incorporated S.A.S. entities must obtain a RUT (Registro Único Tributario) and NIT (Número de Identificación Tributaria) by registering with DIAN. Registration is performed electronically via the DIAN portal using the 'Registro Único Tributario' application. For foreign remitters without a Colombian establishment, the foreign entity must appoint a legal representative in Colombia and submit certified corporate documents, proof of authorized signatory, and a completed RUT form. The NIT is the definitive tax identification for VAT, income tax, and customs purposes.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box regime exists in Colombia. S.A.S. companies are per se corporate income tax payers under Article 12 of the Tax Code. No hybrid mismatch elective classification is available; the entity is directly subject to national corporate income tax at 35% (2023-2024 period), plus complementary taxes. The only election mechanism relevant to the structure is the option to be classified as a 'Régimen Común' VAT responsible party and to voluntarily register for electronic invoicing prior to mandatory thresholds.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: There is no general fixed turnover threshold for S.A.S. VAT registration; any entity engaged in the sale of goods or services, including digital gaming services, must register as a 'Responsable de IVA' in the RUT and in the 'Régimen Común' irrespective of turnover if the activity is taxable. The simplified regime threshold (UVM-based) applies only to natural persons, not juridical entities.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory electronic invoicing (factura electrónica de venta) is enforced by DIAN through Resolution 000165 of 2023 and Resolution 000012 of 2024. B2B and digital-service invoices must be transmitted to DIAN in real-time via authorized software or through the DIAN's free 'Facturación Electrónica' portal. Validation occurs through DIAN's 'Validación previa' API; the invoice receives a CUFE (Código Único de Facturación Electrónica). Digital stamping ('QR code' and CUDE for debit notes) and export invoices must integrate the software-type validation code. All gaming-service transactions to final consumers via IAP/Google Play are also subject to the general electronic invoice obligation unless an equivalent fiscal equivalent ('tiquete de máquina registradora') is authorized by DIAN.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Export of software services and digital content published on foreign platforms qualify for zero-rated (0%) VAT in Colombia if the service is performed within Colombia but the benefit or use is realized abroad, the client is a non-resident entity or person, and the payment originates from abroad. It is also necessary to document that the income is considered an 'export of services' under the Customs law, and the supplier must prove that the contract, invoice, and payment evidence comply with Article 481 of the Tax Code.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Export Customs Declaration (Declaración de Exportación – only for physical media, if applicable)
Commercial Invoice issued under facturación electrónica with export marking
Exit proof for goods (Manifiesto de carga / Bill of Lading for physical media)
Service contract or service order demonstrating cross-border provision
Inward Remittance Certificate or SWIFT/commercial bank credit memorandum evidencing foreign-currency or external bank payment
RUT and NIT certification of exporter and importer
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: DIAN has the power to deny or recover VAT refunds for exports if the required documentary evidence is incomplete or if the zero-rating claim is deemed fraudulent. Penalties for false export declarations or simulated exports include a penalty equal to 160% of the amount of any disallowed refund, plus moratory interest, and possible criminal liability for tax fraud under Law 1943 of 2018 (as amended by Law 2010 of 2019). For services, failure to repatriate foreign-currency proceeds within the 180-day term or failure to prove receipt of payment abroad can result in full reversal of the zero-rate benefit, application of 19% VAT, and VAT surcharges. DIAN also applies the 'anti-abuse rule' of Article 869 of the Tax Code to disregard transactions lacking economic substance, triggering retrospective clawback of refunds and fines up to 200% of the unpaid incremental tax.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banco de la República (Central Bank of Colombia), acting jointly with the Ministry of Finance and Public Credit and the National Planning Department (Departamento Nacional de Planeación) for foreign exchange policy; operational FX control instruments are implemented by the Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia and the Comité de Inversiones Extranjeras.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Colombian peso (COP) is fully convertible on current transactions, including trade in goods, services, and profit remittances, subject to mandatory channeling through authorized foreign exchange intermediaries. Capital account transactions, including foreign direct investment, portfolio investment, and financial credits, are freely permitted after registration with Banco de la República and compliance with tax and AML/CFT formalities. Profit remittance is lawful provided the underlying foreign investment is registered under the 'Registro de Inversiones Internacionales', the right to remit is evidenced in the company's accounts, and all corporate and withholding taxes applicable to remittances (including the 7.5% remittance tax where relevant) have been settled. No express prior exchange control authorization is required for dividend distribution to non-resident shareholders once the investment registration and tax clearances are in place.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Colombian law imposes a mandatory channeling requirement, not a full surrender requirement. All export proceeds in foreign currency must be channeled through the foreign exchange market within six months from the date of shipment for goods, or from the legally stipulated accrual date for services. The exporter may maintain the foreign currency in a domestic foreign-currency account or sell it to the market. There is no fixed statutory conversion ratio mandating that a certain percentage of COP must be obtained; however, proceeds must be repatriated to Colombia and credited to an authorized local financial institution before the deadline. Failure to channel within the term triggers fines, tax recomputation, and loss of FX benefits. For the software services and digital content publishing sector (ISIC 5820), the relevant term commences on the invoice date or contractual service completion date, whichever comes first under the provisions of External Circular DCIP-83.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account (COP and USD denominated); optionally Capital Escrow Account for foreign investment registration
Operational Account and Capital Escrow Account
Capital Escrow Account for foreign investment registration

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low-to-Medium, structurally constrained. Foreign digital EMI or neo-bank providers are not licensed deposit-taking institutions in Colombia and cannot directly access the local clearing system, ACH, or CIFIN/FINCA SAS AML clearinghouse. They may be used merely as a pre-funded disbursement layer for ease of API integration, but the primary treasury account of a Colombian S.A.S. with non-resident shareholders and export activities must reside with a locally authorized credit institution. Any entity performing local payment solicitation or collection must be licensed or registered with the Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia; unlicensed operation would violate the Colombian Financial Regulation framework. Use of EMI rails is viable only as a secondary, non-clearing treasury channel for outbound low-value operational expenses, with a maximum legal rating of 'Medium' if supplemented by a local commercial bank settlement account.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Colombian AML/KYC rules require financial institutions to establish the identity of the legal representative, board members, and ultimate beneficial owners of any corporate client. In practice, tier-1 banks mandate an in-person interview with the legal representative and at least one additional officer with APO (Apoderado) powers at the bank's branch in Colombia. Remote opening is possible only through a regulated 'digital onboarding' process, but for a Buenos Aires or offshore-controlled S.A.S. operating in the online gaming space, banks almost universally require physical attendance or an interview via a notarized power of attorney granted to a Colombian-resident officer or attorney-in-fact, followed by a risk-committee review. The Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia allows video-call validation and document authentication but recommends enhanced due diligence for legal persons with non-resident ownership and gaming exposure, making full physical presence of the appointed local representative the de facto standard.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Beneficial ownership opacity due to foreign holding companies or chain-of-custody complexity
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified corporate registry extract (Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal), notarized corporate bylaws, comprehensive organizational chart with each shareholder name, passport copies, proof of source of funds of each UBO, and sworn declarations identifying ultimate natural persons with more than 5% direct or indirect participation.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Real-money gambling associated reputational classification of the 'social casino / virtual slots' business
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Written legal opinion by a Colombian gaming attorney confirming that the business does not trigger Colombia's 'juegos de suerte y azar' licensing regime, copies of Apple App Store and Google Play terms of compliance evidencing no real-money payouts, audited architecture reports proving no cash-out mechanism, and a robust anti-money laundering and responsible gaming policy.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Suspicious transaction patterns from high-volume IAP/Google Play settlement inflows followed by rapid outbound wires to non-resident shareholders
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Documented treasury policy, invoice ledger, purchase orders, repayment schedules, transfer pricing documentation, audited financial statements showing accrued dividends, and an English/Spanish forensic report explaining the economic substance of each settlement flow.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Tax non-consistency or absence of foreign investment registration (Registro de Inversiones Internacionales)
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Proof of filing with Banco de la República, incorporation certificate, DIAN tax registration (RUT), foreign investment registration certificate, capital contribution wire confirmation, and the 'Formulario para la inversión extranjera' issued by the Central Bank's foreign exchange department.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound foreign direct investment must be routed through a bank authorized to operate the Colombian foreign exchange market. The remitting entity should execute an international wire in USD or EUR using SWIFT with a beneficiary bank located in Colombia, beneficiary being the S.A.S., and a purpose-of-payment code corresponding to 'Inversión extranjera directa de capital en efectivo' (FDI equity injection) as defined in the Balance of Payments manual and Circular DCIP-83. The Colombian receiving bank will require a 'Formulario de Declaración de Cambio' on the date of the transfer, and the entity must present the foreign investment registration certificate issued by Banco de la República within the mandatory calendar time limits. Funds must not be fragmented into small payments; each wire must be individually declared and supported by the shareholder resolution, subscription of shares, or capital increase documentation. If the contribution is made by way of share premium, it must be identified as such and recorded to a capital surplus account.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: The primary outbound clearing rail for trade and operational settlement is the SWIFT network via MT103 wire transfer from the Colombian commercial bank, using the dedicated 'Formulario de Declaración de Cambio' and, where applicable, the payment code for import of software or IP licensing. For larger acquisitions, a commercial letter of credit (UCP 600) may be opened in favor of the seller; the L/C must be issued in COP or USD with SWIFT confirmation, and the Colombian bank will process the documentary presentation and settlement. Where the outbound payment is a royalty or services remittance to a non-resident, the taxpayer must obtain the corresponding withholding tax certificate and furnish it to the bank to evidence compliance. For recurring disbursements to sub-processors, the company may also use the bank's automated clearing platform, but every payment requires underlying invoice support stored for AML audit.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable USD/COP spot foreign exchange transactions executed through authorized FX intermediaries
USD/COP deliverable forwards (forwards sobre tasa de cambio)
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) referencing the COP, subject to Central Bank regulatory conditions and the entity's compliance with end-user documentation
Cross-currency swaps (CCS) between USD and COP, aligned with the actual exposure of the treasury
Plain vanilla foreign exchange options (compra/venta USD/COP) for hedging import, export, and external debt cash flows

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual commercial registration renewal and updated RUES filing (Renovación de la Matrícula Mercantil)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Cámara de Comercio having jurisdiction over the registered office
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually between January 1 and March 31 for the preceding calendar year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late renewal surcharge and daily interest; continued non-renewal triggers cancellation of the commercial registration and administrative strike-off proceedings.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual shareholders' meeting minute and approved financial statements (Acta de Asamblea y Estados Financieros)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Cámara de Comercio commercial registry document filing
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Shareholders' meeting to approve December 31 annual accounts must be held by March 31; deposit at Cámara de Comercio within one month after approval, giving a practical deadline of April 30 for calendar-year filers.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Delayed filing may trigger Superintendencia de Sociedades administrative fines and loss of good-standing registration status; persistent omission is cause for liquidation.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual final beneficial owner declaration (Declaración Anual de Beneficiario Final)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually within the calendar filing window announced by DIAN; generally due within two months after the December 31 fiscal year close.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: DIAN pecuniary penalties under the Tax Statute for late, inaccurate, or omitted filings, up to 10,000 UVT depending on company size.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: An S.A.S. must appoint a Revisor Fiscal if it had total gross assets exceeding 5,000 monthly minimum wages (SMLMV), gross revenues exceeding 3,000 SMLMV, or more than 30 employees in the preceding fiscal year; supervised or public-interest entities are always subject to statutory audit.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: NIIF para las Pymes (IFRS for SMEs) under Decreto 2420 de 2016; full NIIF plenas (full IFRS) is required for Grupo 1 entities exceeding the applicable public-interest and size thresholds.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The S.A.S. must annually file or confirm its final beneficial ownership in the DIAN SIBF system as at December 31. Any share transfer or share issuance must first be entered in the Register of Members and then reflected in the next annual UBO confirmation; no nil-return exemption exists for active S.A.S. entities.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members (Libro de Registro de Accionistas)
Register of Directors (Libro de Actas de Junta Directiva)
Minute Book (Libro de Actas de Asamblea de Accionistas)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: 250–600 per year for registered office support and compliance agent services in Bogotá or Medellín
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: 1,500–4,000 per year for a certified Revisor Fiscal engagement for a mid-sized software subsidiary

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: 9% preferential CIT rate for qualifying Economía Naranja (Orange Economy) enterprises under Law 2010 of 2019 and Decree 2097 of 2019, applied to certified creative/software activities including digital games and software publishing, for up to 7 taxable years and subject to investment and employment thresholds; general CIT is additionally mitigated by annual depreciation, intangible amortization, and foreign tax credit mechanisms.
